result.instruction: In `axil_wr_if`, replace the six-bit `aw_addr` state with a four-bit register containing `{awaddr[5], awaddr[4:2]}` when the AW handshake occurs, and update the out-of-range check and `wr_idx` mapping to use those stored bits. Preserve synchronous active-high reset, AW/W independence, write/response timing, and all channel hold behavior. Leave ignored address bits `[1:0]` out of the state; verify the unchanged top against the frozen testbench and all compile, simulation, routed setup/hold, and metric-integrity gates.
